title: Can You Spot the Order Block? 🧠 ICT Quiz
description: Think you know ICT trading? Test yourself — can you spot the real order block before price moves? Most traders fail this. R2F Trading breaks it down in 30 seconds. Follow for daily ICT concepts, setups, and smart money strategies. r2ftrading.com
script: Stop. Before your next trade — can you actually spot a real order block? 90% of traders get this wrong. Let's find out which side you're on. Here's the setup. Price sweeps a high, drops hard, then consolidates. THREE candles on screen. Which one is the order block? Option A — the big bearish candle. Option B — the last bullish candle before the drop. Option C — the doji at the bottom. Think fast. Most people pick A — the big bearish candle. Looks powerful, right? That's exactly why smart money wants you there. The answer is B. The LAST bullish candle before the aggressive move down. That's where institutional orders lived. That's your order block. The R2F Trading system calls this the Origin Candle. Price always returns to respect it. Miss this — you miss the trade. Every single time. Follow R2F Trading. We post ICT quizzes like this every day.
